data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (gross claims reserves) were GBP 76.621m. The claims development table shows a net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 4.351m (a release), representing a reduction of about 5.7% of opening gross claims. The release arises from favourable claims development in older underwriting years (notably 2011-2013) as shown in the cumulative claims development table; the Syndicate continues to monitor catastrophe exposures via its reinsurance and reserving strategies.
raw_causal_phrases: The tables below show the Syndicate's cumulative incurred claims development, including both claims notified and IBNR for each underwriting year, together with the cumulative payments to date on a gross and net of reinsurance basis at the balance sheet date.
The purpose of these underwriting, reinsurance and reserving strategies is to limit exposure to catastrophes or large losses based on the Syndicate's risk appetite as decided by the Syndicate board.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was not stated explicitly as a single gross figure in a 'movement in prior years' note. PYD was calculated from the published gross claims development table (cumulative gross claims by underwriting year). The triangle was used per the prescribed diagonal method excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2015 and 2014). Amounts in the financial statements are presented in GBP '000; conversions to millions were performed by dividing by 1,000. No line-of-business specific prior-year reserve movements were disclosed, so LOB movements are not provided.
